Audio/Video recording 
 
Ref: Our Letter SD: 193/194/11/12:2026-27 dated 20.07.2026 
 
Further to our intimation on Earnings / Conference call (vide above referred letter) and 
pursuant to the Regulations 30 & 46 of the SEBI (LODR), Regulations 2015, the Stock 
Exchanges are hereby informed that the Bank has conducted an Earning / Conference call to 
discuss the Financial Results of Bank for Quarter ended 30.06.2026 with Analysts/Investors 
today i.e., Monday, 27th July, 2026 at 4.00 pm (IST).  
 
The Q1 FY 2026-27 Earnings conference call audio / video recording is uploaded on Bank’s 
   website and the same can be accessed through below link:
